name: Click Forward
description: The tone up, so the strike's click comes through a mix.

name: Endless Drop
description: Decay and sweep at their ends, the tone low: a boom whose pitch is still falling as it fades.

name: Long Boom
description: The decay most of the way up: a tail that rings for seconds under a beat, with the click kept back.

name: Machine Kick
description: Tone, decay, and sweep at the middle: the machine's own kick, a short snap of pitch and a boom that sighs down to 47 Hz.

name: Round Sub
description: The tone at its darkest and a longer decay: all body, no click.

name: Short Thud
description: The decay well down: a thud with no tail, for a busy pattern.

name: Sighing Drop
description: The sweep past the machine's: the pitch sighs down over most of a second.

name: Tight Punch
description: A shorter decay, a quicker sigh, and a little more click.

name: Long Claves
description: The claves left ringing, their pitch held clear.

name: Low Claves
description: The claves tuned down, nearer a woodblock.

name: Machine Claves
description: The claves at the middle of every knob: the upper shell ringing high.

name: Woodblock Tick
description: The claves tuned up and cut short: a tick for fast patterns.

name: Dark Hat
description: The closed hat with its band and high-pass moved down: duller, nearer a shaker.

name: Loose Hat
description: The closed hat let ring a little, between closed and open.

name: Machine Closed Hat
description: The closed hat as the machine has it: a short, bright tick of six square waves.

name: Sizzle Hat
description: The closed hat with its band and high-pass moved up: thin and bright.

name: Tight Hat
description: The closed hat cut to a click, for fast patterns.

name: Agogo
description: The cowbell tuned up and shortened, nearer an agogo bell.

name: Choked Bell
description: The cowbell at its shortest: a clank.

name: Clank
description: The cowbell at the top of its tune and cut short.

name: Deep Bell
description: The cowbell an octave down, ringing long.

name: High Cowbell
description: The cowbell tuned up a little.

name: Low Cowbell
description: The cowbell tuned down a little.

name: Machine Cowbell
description: The cowbell as the machine has it: two square waves, a sharp start and a long ring.

name: Short Cowbell
description: The cowbell cut short.

name: Bright Cymbal
description: The cymbal with its bright band turned up.

name: Dark Cymbal
description: The cymbal with its bright band turned down: all ring and little splash.

name: Long Crash
description: The cymbal at its longest and a little brighter.

name: Low Cymbal
description: The cymbal with its bands at their lowest, ringing long.

name: Machine Cymbal
description: The cymbal as the machine has it: a bright splash that rings on lower.

name: Short Cymbal
description: The cymbal at its shortest.

name: Splash
description: The cymbal brightened, raised, and cut short.

name: Wash
description: The cymbal darkened and lowered, ringing long, nearer a ride's wash.

name: Bright Clap
description: The clap with its band moved up: sharper and nearer.

name: Dark Clap
description: The clap with its band moved down: thicker and further off.

name: Machine Hand Clap
description: The hand clap at the middle of its tone: three quick slaps and the reverberation after.

name: Thin Clap
description: The clap at the top of its tone, for a light backbeat.

name: Bongo Tap
description: The high conga tuned up and cut short.

name: High Conga
description: The high conga.

name: Machine High Tom
description: The high tom at the middle of every knob.

name: Low Conga
description: The low conga: the low tom's circuit with its capacitors switched out, higher and without the noise.

name: Deep Floor Tom
description: The low tom tuned down, its decay drawn out, and more of its tail.

name: Machine Low Tom
description: The low tom at the middle of every knob, with its tail of pink noise.

name: Bright Shaker
description: The maracas brightened to an airy hiss.

name: Machine Maracas
description: The maracas at the middle of their tone: a short hiss that swells and stops.

name: Muffled Maracas
description: The maracas at the bottom of their tone.

name: Soft Shaker
description: The maracas darkened, for a shaker that sits back.

name: Mid Conga
description: The mid conga.

name: Machine Mid Tom
description: The mid tom at the middle of every knob.

name: Long Open Hat
description: The open hat at its longest, a wash under the beat.

name: Machine Open Hat
description: The open hat as the machine has it: the same metal, left to ring.

name: Short Open Hat
description: The open hat shortened to a quick hiss.

name: High Rim
description: The rim shot tuned to its top.

name: Machine Rim Shot
description: The rim shot at the middle of every knob: both shells clipped into a bright knock.

name: Ringing Rim
description: The rim shot let ring, its lower shell sounding on under the knock.

name: Tight Rim
description: The rim shot cut short, all knock and no ring.

name: Crack
description: The tone toward the upper shell and more snappy: a short, bright crack.

name: Fat Body
description: The tone toward the lower shell and the snappy down: more drum than snares.

name: Long Hiss
description: Snappy and decay at their tops, the tone bright: a wash of noise past the machine's.

name: Machine Snare
description: Tone, snappy, and decay at the middle: the machine's own snare, two shells and a burst of noise.

name: Ringing Shells
description: The snappy all but off: the two shells alone, a pitched knock.

name: Soft Brush
description: The snappy low and the decay long: a quiet hiss for ballads.

name: Tight Snap
description: The decay down: a short snap for a busy pattern.

name: Wire Rattle
description: Snappy near its top and the decay drawn out: the snares ring on after the shells.
